description: This file defines an Angular standalone component 'NoteViewComponent' that displays a note's details, allows editing, deletion, and navigation back to the list. It uses services to retrieve and delete notes, and includes UI templates and styles.

classes.name: NoteViewComponent
classes.description: An Angular component responsible for viewing a specific note, with functionalities to edit, delete, and navigate back.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, subscribes to route parameters to load the note based on ID.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Navigates to the edit page for the current note.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Confirms deletion and removes the note via the service, then navigates back to the list.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Navigates back to the notes list view.
